extensions.name: Boards
extensions.description: Kanban boards drawn from markdown, where dragging a card rewrites the note. It runs sandboxed.

extensions.name: Pomodoro
extensions.description: Work in focused rounds with breaks between: `::pomodoro{work=25m break=5m}`. It shows in the status bar and notifies at each change. It runs sandboxed.

extensions.name: HTML app
extensions.description: Small apps in notes: an ```html-app block's HTML runs in a sandboxed frame, with three.js and uPlot to import by name. It can't reach the network or your notes.
